question: Which of the following civic bodies was declared as the ‘Best Performing Municipal Corporation’ in India in December 2020 for implementing the Pradhan Mantri Awas YojanaUrban Mission? The annual awards were announced by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Greater Vishakhapatnam Municipal Corporation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Greater Vishakhapatnam Municipal Corporation was declared as the ‘Best Performing Municipal Corporation’ in India in December 2020 for implementing the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana Urban Mission**__.

 __
 
• Satraboina Durga, a housing beneficiary of Ward No. 50 of Gajuwaka, was selected under the ‘best house construction’ category.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Reason for GVMC winning the award**-

 
 
• Ms. Durga used to reside in a thatched house and used to spend at least ₹6,000 replacing thatched roof every year.
 
• The GVMC had allocated a pucca house to the family under PMAY- Urban Housing Programme. While the unit cost of the house is ₹3.5 lakh, the Union government offered a subsidy of ₹1.5 lakh, and the State government ₹1 lakh.
 
• The GVMV provided all the civic amenities such as water supply, underground drainage, C.C roads, street-lighting, etc.
 
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban (PMAY-U), a flagship Mission of the Government of India being implemented by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA), was launched on the 25th June 2015.**
 
• The Mission addresses urban housing shortage among the EWS/LIG and MIG categories including the slum dwellers by ensuring a pucca house to all eligible urban households by the year 2022 when India completes 75 years of its Independence.
